Subject: Supplier control information request — SIG/CAIQ scope

Hi Alex,

We're kicking off the vendor evidence collection for our SIG/CAIQ review for GovHealth's upcoming deployment window. Can you please provide the following by 2026-05-20: 

- A current subprocessor inventory (name, role, data processed, region).
- A supplier control matrix mapping each supplier to the SIG control families and any compensating controls.
- A redacted SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC audit letter) and the date range covered.
- CAIQ/Consensus answers or a completed CAIQ export (if you maintain one).
- Network diagram (high level) and KMS/HSM certificate/attestation information.
- Confirmation whether LogiStream (our log analytics vendor) has access to any PII when integrated with your telemetry.

We can accept redacted SOC2 reports and a secure link to downloads. If any items will take longer, please flag which ones and propose an ETA. Our security reviewer (cc'd) will triage the incoming artifacts.

Thanks,
Maya R.
Maya Ruiz | Vendor Risk Lead, GovHealth
